title: Space Group Conditional Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2509.23822v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Inorganic crystals are periodic, highly-symmetric arrangements of atoms in three-dimensional space. Their structures are constrained by the symmetry operations of a crystallographic \emph{space group} and restricted to lie in specific affine subspaces known as \emph{Wyckoff positions}. The frequency an atom appears in the crystal and its rough positioning are determined by its Wyckoff position. Most generative models that predict atomic coordinates overlook these symmetry constraints, leading to unrealistically high populations of proposed crystals exhibiting limited symmetry. We introduce Space Group Conditional Flow Matching, a novel generative framework that samples significantly closer to the target population of highly-symmetric, stable crystals. translated_abstract: 无机晶体是原子在三维空间中周期性、高度对称的排列。其结构受到晶体学空间群对称操作的约束，并被限制在称为Wyckoff位置的特定仿射子空间中。原子在晶体中出现的频率及其大致位置由其Wyckoff位置决定。大多数预测原子坐标的生成模型忽略了这些对称性约束，导致所提出的晶体中出现低对称性结构的比例不切实际地偏高。我们提出了空间群条件流匹配，这是一种新颖的生成框架，其采样结果显著更接近目标的高对称性、稳定晶体分布。我们通过将整个生成过程以给定的空间群和Wyckoff位置集合为条件来实现这一目标；具体而言，我们定义了一个条件对称的噪声基分布……
tldr: 提出空间群条件流匹配生成框架，通过以空间群和Wyckoff位置为条件约束整个生成过程，显著提升了生成高对称性稳定无机晶体的能力。
en_tdlr: We introduce Space Group Conditional Flow Matching, a novel generative framework that conditions the entire generation process on space groups and Wyckoff positions, enabling sampling of highly-symmetric, stable inorganic crystals significantly closer to the target population.
